newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares pulled lower by BTC.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares pulled lower by BTC.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.11 percent on Wednesday, dragged down by profit-taking in shopping centre operator BTC.

Traders forecast little movement in the overall market ahead of a decision by parliament on ratification of Slovenia's association agreement with the European Union. Parliament is expected to vote on the issue within two weeks.
* The SBI index fell 1.49 points to 1,317.40.

* Warehouse and shopping centre operator BTC was the most active, falling 1.45 percent to 14,290 tolars on volume of 972 shares. Traders said the move was a reversal after the stock firmed two percent over a 10-day period. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
